name: What are common signs that indicate my roof needs a seasonal inspection?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that indicate my roof needs a seasonal inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs that indicate your roof needs a seasonal inspection include visible damage like missing, cracked, or curled shingles, especially after a storm. You might also notice granules in your gutters, which suggests shingle deterioration. Interior signs such as water stains on ceilings or walls, or a musty odor in the attic, are also critical indicators. Even if no obvious damage is present, a proactive inspection can uncover hidden issues before they worsen. Considering the rapid weather changes in the DFW area, regular checks are prudent.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for missing or damaged shingles, granules in gutters, or interior water stains. Even without visible damage, a proactive inspection helps identify hidden issues early, especially in the DFW area.
